sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding bundle the fastener kit with one distributor.
Our latest forecast for part:360010 grows +6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 30,000 complete bundles of part:360010, part:360011, part:360012, part:360030 per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome the 36-month volume commitment and have factored the verified forecast increase into our calculation. 

Our offer is a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Following your suggestion to accelerate payment for a better rate, we propose a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

As a distributor, we cannot provide a detailed cost breakdown, but we assure you our rates are highly competitive. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. It is always a pleasure supporting your range with our service, and this Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Thank you for providing the forecast data; however, please note that these volume changes were already factored into our previous calculations. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is a price of €5.47 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

In response to your improved offer, we are prepared to reduce our price to €5.44 per unit for the 60-day payment term over a 36-month contract. We believe this is a highly competitive rate that supports your planning certainty while accommodating your preferred terms.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
